comment: P2-1 constrained terminology expansion. Bounded synonym tables scoped by classification domain: expansion terms are APPENDED to derived English branch queries only (never rewrite the user query), at most MAX_RULES_PER_QUERY rules and MAX_TERMS_PER_RULE terms each, skipping terms already present. A rule may add when.require_any (query must mention a trigger term) because subjects are domain-derived and would otherwise fire on unrelated in-domain queries (e.g. relief synonyms on a registry question). Research grounding: vocabulary gap user-register vs official-register (audit F1). No LLM expansion.
